# Liquid AI Data Processing Terms (demo mirror)

Illustrative content for the Night's Watch hackathon demo. Not Liquid AI's actual terms.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

## Scope

These terms describe how Liquid AI processes customer data on behalf of its customers when providing hosted AI model inference.

## Use of customer data

Prompts and outputs are processed only to return inference results to the customer. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention

Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination. Tax and invoice records are retained for 7 years as required by law.

## Security

We encrypt customer data in transit and at rest and isolate inference workloads per customer. We train our support staff on data protection every year.

## Changes to sub-processors

We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor. Customers may object to a new sub-processor during the notice period.
